description: Event types the official actusfrf testbeds (vendor/actus/tests) and the techspec use but the v1.4 dictionary event vocabulary lacks. The generator appends them to EventType; tests/dictionary.rs checks this list is exactly the set of non-dictionary event types in the vendored testbeds. See docs/spec-interpretations.md SI-005.

eventTypes.name: Principal Increase
eventTypes.sequenceReason: the PR sequence: PI is the ARINCDEC=INC counterpart of PR in the LAX schedule; the LAX testbed orders same-day PI before IP
eventTypes.techspec: LAX schedule l. 1298, LAX functions l. 1402

eventTypes.name: Interest Payment Fixed Leg
eventTypes.sequenceReason: the IP sequence: the SWPPV testbed orders same-day IPFX, IPFL, RR
eventTypes.techspec: SWPPV schedule IP^(fix) l. 2130, functions l. 2211

eventTypes.name: Interest Payment Floating Leg
eventTypes.sequenceReason: the IP sequence: the SWPPV testbed orders same-day IPFX, IPFL, RR (IPFX is emitted first; the sort is stable)
eventTypes.techspec: SWPPV schedule IP^(var) l. 2135, functions l. 2215
